findings.title: Source-image channel provenance is unavailable
findings.impact: The calibration/provenance record cannot independently demonstrate that the analyzed image channel is the intended channel for every source plane. Filenames imply ch00, but the retained manifests explicitly store channel as null, leaving channel selection and alignment dependent on inference from filenames.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/provenance/specimens/kj_sv_40xx0.75-1/settings/source_image_manifest.json:6-10 records Project001_Series002_z00_ch00.tif with "channel": null.
audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/provenance/specimens/w1118_sv_feb_40xx0.75-1/settings/source_image_manifest.json:6-10 records Project001_Series001_z00_ch00.tif with "channel": null.
audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json:11-19 records source image and calibration metadata but no resolved channel field.
audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/provenance/specimens/kj_sv_40xx0.75-1/settings/runtime_parameters.json contains SINGLE_TEST_IMAGE ending in _ch00.tif but no explicit selected-channel value.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the RC5 provenance manifests with an explicit resolved channel identifier for every ordered source image and record the channel-selection rule or metadata field used to verify it.

limitations: Original source TIFF files and external source directories were not available under the retained repository evidence, so source-image hashes and channel labels could not be independently recomputed.
No full-stack inference or destructive operation was performed.
recommended_follow_up: Add explicit channel provenance to both specimen source_image_manifest.json files and rerun the evidence provenance validator.
Obtain an independent review of the corrected channel alignment before acceptance.
